description: This Kotlin source file defines the NoteEditActivity class, which is an Android activity for creating and editing notes. It includes UI setup, interaction with a NotesRepository, and menu actions for saving, deleting, and navigating.

classes.name: NoteEditActivity
classes.description: An activity class for editing or creating notes, supporting menu actions and interactions with the notes data repository.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the toolbar and input fields, and loads note data if editing an existing note.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and configures menu item visibility based on whether editing an existing note.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for saving, deleting, and navigation actions.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Collects input data and saves the note via the notes repository, showing validation errors if title is empty.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the current note if it exists.
